title: Determination 2023/027: The compliance with clause E2 of a proposed direct-fixed plywood cladding system (pathway using BRANZ Appraisal no 765)
jurisdiction: New Zealand: Auckland Council as building consent authority; MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004. Non-Alberta comparative record.
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992). E2/AS1 is cited (edition not named in the text read). BRANZ Appraisal no 765 (2017) is relied on for the pathway.

facts.text: The proposed direct-fixed plywood cladding system is on a building at Forrest Hill, Auckland. The question is whether it complies with E2.3.2.
The designer relies on BRANZ Appraisal no 765 (2017) as evidence of compliance. The appraisal's scope requires a risk score between 0 and 6, calculated in E2/AS1.
The parties disagree about the risk score. The designer challenges the authority's decision that the apron flashings at roof/wall junctions are very high risk.
The designer says the roof/wall junction does not match the examples in E2/AS1 paragraph 3.4.2 or Figure 7, where a cavity is needed for the wall below the flashing.
